scope: Synthetic in-memory complete native macro_step; explicit controlled sparse and acquisition fixtures, no durable owner or real workload performance claim

engine.timer: Measured macro_steps only; config, input/state construction, singleton/path bootstrap, cache clear, assertions, serialization and process launch excluded
engine.cache: repeated_path retains cache after path bootstrap; cold_acquisition resets current-thread memoizer after singleton bootstrap for every episode
engine.configuration: force-commit thresholds plus extraction convergence_tau=1, adaptation split_threshold=3, merge_distance=0
engine.golden: Complete serialized SemanticCrystal values plus prior selected-state fields at EVERY bootstrap and measured tick, exact four-way bytes before timing
engine.shape: actual full graph vertex and edge counts; full crystal regions; presence/absence and n,m of signature; every tick commits
engine.actual_keys: Golden trace independently records crystal region order and induced adjacency bits, not inferred from requested workload name

primary_metric: ticks_per_s = measured committed ticks / measured elapsed interval; paired ratio of per-process median ticks/s
statistics: Five paired process ratios with alternating order; median,min,max only, no population-level confidence claim
